## Description

Integrates outputs from multiple domain analyses (market intelligence, financial analysis, legal/regulatory review, M&A special-topic checks) into a single unified strategic view for a stage-gate decision. Includes a mandatory cross-domain conflict-resolution step so tensions between analyses are recorded, never silently averaged away. Use when: "synthesize insights", "insight synthesis", "integrate analysis", "strategic synthesis", "combine findings", "cross-analysis integration".
